title: सप्तचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 147 · The daughter and the little son

summary.en: The daughter offers herself to save her parents, and the family weep together. The little son, waving a blade of grass, says he will kill the demon with it, and Kunti steps in to ask the cause of their grief.
summary.kn: ತಂದೆತಾಯಿಯರನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಲು ಮಗಳು ತನ್ನನ್ನು ಅರ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಕುಟುಂಬವೆಲ್ಲ ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಅಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಪುಟ್ಟ ಮಗನು ಹುಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಡ್ಡಿ ಬೀಸುತ್ತಾ ಇದರಿಂದ ರಾಕ್ಷಸನನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುವೆನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಕುಂತಿ ಮುಂದೆ ಬಂದು ದುಃಖದ ಕಾರಣ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: माता-पिता को बचाने के लिए पुत्री स्वयं को अर्पित करती है, और परिवार साथ मिलकर रोता है। नन्हा पुत्र तिनका घुमाते हुए कहता है कि वह इससे राक्षस को मार डालेगा, और कुन्ती आगे आकर उनके दुःख का कारण पूछती हैं।
summary.te: తల్లిదండ్రులను కాపాడడానికి కుమార్తె తనను అర్పించుకుంటుంది, కుటుంబమంతా కలిసి ఏడుస్తుంది. చిన్న కుమారుడు గడ్డిపోచ ఊపుతూ దీనితో రాక్షసుని చంపుతానంటాడు; కుంతి ముందుకు వచ్చి వారి దుఃఖకారణం అడుగుతుంది.
summary.ta: பெற்றோரைக் காக்க மகள் தன்னை அர்ப்பணிக்க, குடும்பம் முழுவதும் சேர்ந்து அழுகிறது. சிறு மகன் புல் தண்டை வீசியபடி இதனால் அரக்கனைக் கொல்வேன் என்கிறான்; குந்தி முன்வந்து அவர்கள் துயரத்தின் காரணத்தைக் கேட்கிறாள்.
summary.ml: മാതാപിതാക്കളെ രക്ഷിക്കാൻ മകൾ സ്വയം സമർപ്പിക്കുന്നു; കുടുംബം ഒന്നിച്ചു കരയുന്നു. ചെറിയ മകൻ ഒരു പുല്ലിൻതണ്ട് വീശിക്കൊണ്ട്, അതുകൊണ്ടുതന്നെ രാക്ഷസനെ കൊല്ലുമെന്ന് പറയുന്നു; കുന്തി ഇടപെട്ട് ദുഃഖത്തിന്റെ കാരണം അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.147; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तयोर्दुःखितयोर्वाक्यमतिमात्रं निशम्य तत् ।
भृशं दुःखपरीताङ्गी कन्या तावभ्यभाषत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that extreme sorrow of the two, the daughter, her limbs overwhelmed with grief, spoke to them.

verses.text:
किमिदं भृशदुःखार्तौ रोरवीथो अनाथवत् ।
ममापि श्रूयतां किंचिच्छ्रुत्वा च क्रियतां क्षमम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Why do you two cry, afflicted with great grief, as if you had no one to turn to? Hear a word from me, and then do what is fitting.

verses.text:
धर्मतोऽहं परित्याज्या युवयोर्नात्र संशयः ।
त्यक्तव्यां मां परित्यज्य त्रातं सर्वं मयैकया ॥

meaning.en: 'By dharma I am surely the one you must give up, without doubt. By giving up me, who must be given up, everything can be saved by me alone.

verses.text:
इत्यर्थमिष्यतेऽपत्यं तारयिष्यति मामिति ।
तस्मिन्नुपस्थिते काले तरतं प्लववन्मया ॥

meaning.en: 'For this one wants children: thinking, 'She will carry me across.' When that time has come, cross over with me as with a raft.

verses.text:
इह वा तारयेद्दुर्गादुत वा प्रेत्य तारयेत् ।
सर्वथा तारयेत्पुत्रः पुत्र इत्युच्यते बुधैः ॥

meaning.en: 'A child saves from danger either here or after death; in every way a child saves, and so the wise call a son 'putra'.

verses.text:
आकाङ्क्षन्ते च दौहित्रानपि नित्यं पितामहाः ।
तान्स्वयं वै परित्रास्ये रक्षन्ती जीवितं पितुः ॥

meaning.en: 'Grandfathers too always long for daughters' sons. I myself will save them by protecting my father's life.

verses.text:
भ्राता च मम बालोऽयं गते लोकममुं त्वयि ।
अचिरेणैव कालेन विनश्येत न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: 'And this little brother of mine, if you go to the other world, would perish soon, without doubt.

verses.text:
तातेऽपि हि गते स्वर्गं विनष्टे च ममानुजे ।
पिण्डः पितॄणां व्युच्छिद्येत्तत्तेषामप्रियं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: 'And if Father went to heaven and my younger brother perished, the funeral cake of the ancestors would be cut off, and that would displease them.

verses.text:
पित्रा त्यक्ता तथा मात्रा भ्रात्रा चाहमसंशयम् ।
दुःखाद्दुःखतरं प्राप्य म्रियेयमतथोचिता ॥

meaning.en: 'Abandoned by father, mother and brother, I would surely die, going from sorrow to worse sorrow, in a way I do not deserve.

verses.text:
त्वयि त्वरोगे निर्मुक्ते माता भ्राता च मे शिशुः ।
संतानश्चैव पिण्डश्च प्रतिष्ठास्यत्यसंशयम् ॥

meaning.en: 'But if you are freed unharmed, my mother, my brother, the child, the line and the offering will surely stand firm.

verses.text:
आत्मा पुत्रः सखा भार्या कृच्छ्रं तु दुहिता किल ।
स कृच्छ्रान्मोचयात्मानं मां च धर्मेण योजय ॥

meaning.en: 'It is said that the self is the son, a wife the friend, but a daughter is trouble. So free yourself from trouble and set me on dharma.

verses.text:
अनाथा कृपणा बाला यत्रक्वचनगामिनी ।
भविष्यामि त्वया तात विहीना कृपणा बत ॥

meaning.en: 'Without you, Father, I would be helpless, wretched, young, going anywhere, and pitiable indeed.

verses.text:
अथ वाहं करिष्यामि कुलस्यास्य विमोक्षणम् ।
फलसंस्था भविष्यामि कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Or else I will free this family, and having done a very hard deed I will have its reward.

verses.text:
अथ वा यास्यसे तत्र त्यक्त्वा मां द्विजसत्तम ।
पीडिताहं भविष्यामि तदवेक्षस्व मामपि ॥

meaning.en: 'But if you go there, best of Brahmins, leaving me, I will be tormented; think of me as well.

verses.text:
तदस्मदर्थं धर्मार्थं प्रसवार्थं च सत्तम ।
आत्मानं परिरक्षस्व त्यक्तव्यां मां च संत्यज ॥

meaning.en: 'So for our sake, for dharma and for the line, good Father, protect yourself and give up me, who must be given up.

verses.text:
अवश्यकरणीयेऽर्थे मा त्वां कालोऽत्यगादयम् ।
त्वया दत्तेन तोयेन भविष्यति हितं च मे ॥

meaning.en: 'In a matter that must be done, do not let this time pass. The water you offer me later will do me good.

verses.text:
किं न्वतः परमं दुःखं यद्वयं स्वर्गते त्वयि ।
याचमानाः परादन्नं परिधावेमहि श्ववत् ॥

meaning.en: 'What could be worse than that, when you are gone to heaven, we should wander begging food from others like dogs?

verses.text:
त्वयि त्वरोगे निर्मुक्ते क्लेशादस्मात्सबान्धवे ।
अमृते वसती लोके भविष्यामि सुखान्विता ॥

meaning.en: 'If you are freed unharmed from this affliction, with your family, I will live happy in the deathless world.'

verses.text:
एवं बहुविधं तस्या निशम्य परिदेवितम् ।
पिता माता च सा चैव कन्या प्ररुरुदुस्त्रयः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing her many sorrowing words, father, mother and the girl all three wept aloud.

verses.text:
ततः प्ररुदितान्सर्वान्निशम्याथ सुतस्तयोः ।
उत्फुल्लनयनो बालः कलमव्यक्तमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, hearing them all weeping, their little son, his eyes wide, said in a sweet, unclear voice:

verses.text:
मा रोदीस्तात मा मातर्मा स्वसस्त्वमिति ब्रुवन् ।
प्रहसन्निव सर्वांस्तानेकैकं सोऽपसर्पति ॥

meaning.en: 'Don't cry, Father, Mother, Sister,' he said, and, almost laughing, he went from one to another.

verses.text:
ततः स तृणमादाय प्रहृष्टः पुनरब्रवीत् ।
अनेन तं हनिष्यामि राक्षसं पुरुषादकम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the child picked up a blade of grass and said gladly, 'With this I will kill that man-eating rakshasa.'

verses.text:
तथापि तेषां दुःखेन परीतानां निशम्य तत् ।
बालस्य वाक्यमव्यक्तं हर्षः समभवन्महान् ॥

meaning.en: Even so, in their grief, hearing the child's unclear words, a great joy arose in them.

verses.text:
अयं काल इति ज्ञात्वा कुन्ती समुपसृत्य तान् ।
गतासूनमृतेनेव जीवयन्तीदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing this was the moment, Kunti came near and spoke to them, giving life to the lifeless as with nectar.
